title: Poster by @mrblackstudio: It’s a pure joy watching a client you rebranded and launched a new web
notes:
It’s a pure joy watching a client you rebranded and launched a new website for just blow up. Moved to a bigger studio. Team also grew bigger. And now clients paying them to travel cross border for shoots. Love seeing good people doing great things and being rewarded for it.

Designer: @mrblackstudio. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
